points.description: Final answer is 2 good days left, reached by valid working: the remaining 6 days after the first 24 contain 12 − 8 = 4 good days, and after the next three days (good, neutral, good) that leaves 4 − 2 = 2 good days. Equivalent correct methods, such as counting the remaining days by type, earn the mark. Any wrong step or wrong final answer earns no mark, as the model answer requires.

rubric.notes: The question has a single idea, so there is one all-or-nothing point worth the full mark. Full marks require the answer 2 with every step valid. Any arithmetic or logic error, or a wrong final answer, earns nothing.
